entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for a VeloBand I just bought.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's David Chen, order number VF-881-92B.

Thank you, David. I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered about a week ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The device is just not working. I've tried everything in the manual, but it just won't sync with my phone or the app.
I see. And you've confirmed your phone's Bluetooth is on and the band is fully charged?
Of course. I've charged it overnight twice now. At this point, I have to assume the unit I received is broken or defective. I'd rather not troubleshoot anymore and just return it.
I completely understand your frustration, David, and I'm very sorry you received a defective item. Let me just check our return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Okay, I've pulled up the policy. It looks like all our items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, that's great news. So we can process that now?

Absolutely. I am processing the return authorization for you right now. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the item back in its original box and use that label.

Okay, simple enough. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did receive a faulty product and have to go through the hassle of sending it back, is there any possibility of a discount code for a future purchase? I'm a long-time customer and plan to re-order this, hopefully with better luck.

That's a fair request, and let me see... yes, I do see you're listed as a VIP customer. I want to thank you for your loyalty and apologize again for the trouble. As a gesture of goodwill, I've added a $25 credit directly to your VeloFit account. You can apply it to your next order.
A $25 credit is perfect. Thank you, Alex, I really appreciate that. You've been very helpful.
It's my pleasure, David. I'm glad I could resolve this to your satisfaction. The return is initiated and your credit is ready when you are. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
